title: Ascension Ladder Implementation Plan
summary: Implementation plan for recording which of 17 ascension-ladder rungs each game reaches, via a stdlib ladder module and bench display.
notes: Implementation plan with task steps, file lists, interfaces and global constraints; no ADR status field or user stories. Closest taxonomy fit is SPEC (implementation contracts: interfaces, constraints). Plan-document shape is not an explicit taxonomy category. Source file path is not under an adr/prd/spec/rfc directory.
